column3: For Kazmodan!
Feel the fury of the mountain!
strength, honor. I see them in you. Why have you come?
What brings you to Ironforge?
How can the dwarves help you?
What do you seek within the mountain?
Well, best be setting sail to Ironforge, no sense in dawdling.
Argh! And who is this?
Goddess? You mean Azeroth? Aye, I was her speaker for many years, but she's let me go from that service.
Aye, it can be lonely following a path that others can't see, but don't make the same mistake I did, putting it all on yourself.
Look for those who will walk the path with you. If I've learned anything, it's that we'll always need each other to not lose ourselves on the journey.
Best of luck to you, Orwena. One day, when you found what you're looking for, I hope you too find your way home.
Smooth, isn't it? Who'd have thought it'd be like a wee bairn's bottom underneath?
I'm ready for anything!
Prefer all diplomatic questions to my daughter, Moira!
Magni! In the flesh!
Champion! Good to see you!
We must forge ahead!
Azeroth still needs us!
Ah, glad you're here.
Who knows what we'll find deep in the earth!
Come and get some, you kite-less bastard!
edicts, oath sworn, it all sounds daft to me.
Get those doors open lad, and fast.
All this garden, twisted into something they never asked to become.
I'll be damned if I let Brin's people be turned into monsters!
I've seen rooms like this before! There's Titan Machinery in here!
I know a lot. I know.
I'm coming with you, lad. Prince, we'll be back soon.
This isn't one of your books, lad. Watch your step.
I doubt it. The entrance has boarded up.
Whatever my people need me, I will go.
I know you want to help lad, but this is a ghost town!
Sounded like another deep flare. Let's move on.
Fewer workers, it would seem. Is it because the earthen are shutting down?
The forge is still hot. Someone was here recently.
It came from that building!
Enough knocking, champion! We're breaking this thing down!
Dagarin, it's time to go.
Wait, I can hear wind blowing, from beyond the stone.
It must have been a controlled cave-in! Champion, help us destroy the blockage!
Is that... the Foreman? You were right, lad!
We cannot give in. We must keep fighting.
Come on, we can't let that thing out of this cave!
We were... too late. How many times have I been too late?
We have to tell Brents! Hurry!
You
What changed your mind?
SPEAK TO ME!
The place she's calling us to!
Ugh!
We'll help you.
We're here to help!
I would never succeed without my clan and family.
What's happening to them?
Stay back, GLAAD!
Get away from him!
Aaargh!
I don't know.
We'll figure it out later.
I can hear more coming.
AHHH!
What are you trying to tell us?
Azeroth depends on us.
KEEP LISTIN'!
Everyone deserves a second chance.
If you're trying to polish me, put a wee bit more elbow grease in. Here, see, wax on, wax off, wax on, wax off.
I got no counsel for you! No advice!
Look, I'm not dead yet!
SPEAK UP!
Even though I'm bone to serving Azeroth.
I'm speaking for no one these days.
Well, out with it.
For Azeroth.
I'll press on till Azeroth is done with me.
No rest for we heroes, hey champion!
Eh, off with ya.
Keep fighting, champion!
Always more work to be done.
When the world is healed, may some healing be spent on me.
Sometimes Destiny whispers, sometimes she shouts.

Azeroth!
I can hear her voice!
I can see it!
IT'S COLD!
AHHHHHHHHHH
Azeroth showed me a vision of a city in flames in the ancient lands of Khaz'algar.
Her voice was desperate. We must act quickly!
I lost, but I saw a vision of destruction.
And the name, Kaz Algar.
Moira, can I speak with you?
I can see that better than I would have done with these machines.
I just wanted to say, I'm proud of you.
No! And I deserve that. I've done some things I'm not proud of.
But in spite of me, you've grown up to have a keen mind for governing and the heart to let Dagram be the man he'll be.
I only wanted to protect you, and I've not done a good job of it, we're in grave danger, even now.
But you don't need me anymore, and it does me good to see how strong you are.
And that when I'm gone, you'll carry on and rule with a grace and strength I could only dream about.
How I look, to be honest, the shine has worn off of me, and of this speaker nonsense.
An honour, aye, until it wasn't, A song everywhere, a nary a peep for me.
And now drag to the ends of the earth and my family too!
Right, you're in the same boat, aren't you lad? But the light seems a fairer master. I doubt it has left you truly endowin'.
That may be. But if I were you, I'd enjoy my break from being a king and saviour of the world. Figure yourself out. Rest.
Diagram, lad, I'm concerned about you.
Oh, it does my heart good to see you! So excited about this! But I'm concerned about your safety!
Oh, you've got a good eye for solving problems, lad, but not for danger. You've got a brave heart, but you're reckless.
Sometimes I think you're so distracted figuring things out that you leap before you look.
Me? What do you mean?
Aye, I've had a burden to bear for too long. I just don't want you to get hurt, lad.
Hahaha, aye lad. I'll enjoy them even more when I'm with you. It's a deal.
Needn't you mind? Had a stray thought. Thank you for jogging my memory.
Azeroth, you fox. Did you do this on purpose? To pave the way here for us?
These other Threigar, they look akin to me.
duties. I, um, can you refresh my memory of what those are?
Uh-huh. Oh, right. Me? Oh, yes, yes, yes. A thing out of old I am.
Ah, I've got a lot to make up for. For a long time, I knew I needed to protect Azeroth.
I gave up a lot. I gave up too much. I should have spent more time protecting you and daggering.
I know. I want to be here for him as his granda.
I wasn't responsible enough. That needs to change.
I've spent too many years listening to Azeroth's voice. I'm glad I can listen to yours now.
I feel humbled, like I've carried a burden for a long time, like I've finally been forgiven. I've had debts to pay.
Alas, my old life, I can't live my life that way.
I understand. I've changed, and my life has changed. I don't want to live in the past. I want our family to have a future.
Onward and upward. On to the next adventure.
If this is about the visions, I'm near interested. Leave me alone!
Speaker of Azeroth! Pfft! She hasn't been speaking to me!
After all I gave, she left me like this, unable to feel the warmth of my kin's embrace.
So, let's be clear, I'm doing this for all of you, not for her!
You
Ah, Laddie, we're not chasing magic, that!
You've seen others akin to me?
Now don't you be talking to my daughter like that, ya great stone!
We can't even hold them!
Do you think the Arathe are here somewhere in Kazulgar?
I don't know what to make of it, the earthen are also an ancient people, they might be just remembering ghosts.
Aye, I heard that too.
Oh, you know, titans, edicts, phragga...
These earthen, they're a funny lot, odd traditions, superstitions.

She is trying to send me a message. A warning, he thinks. But something's not right with her.
Meet me and show us our basin up in Northrend. Together, we'll get to the bottom of this.
A shame Bran didn't come with you. Nothing my brother loves more than openin' Titan doors.
I sense her fear. Her doubt. We've got to help her. Looks like some of the defenses are down. If you reactivate them, it might help snap her out of this.
You did it! The nightmares are contained! Keep going. I'm just ahead in the next chamber.
Champion! Azeroth needs her help!
Ah, you're getting close. Come to the Maker's Overlook, high in the eastern mountains. I'll show you the way inside.
Here you go. This pad'll bring you deep below ground to a place no mortal has walked in millennia. The Hall of Communion. Come on down. I've got a lot to show you.
Lately, she seemed troubled, hard to read. I hope you can help me get through to her.
Something's triggered the defences! Careful now, you've got company!
These phantoms must be her dreams, her nightmares. If we help her overcome these horrors, Azeroth should be able to give us her message.
Talk to me lass, tell me what's got you all in a tizzy.
The Dark Titan comes. We've got to stop him. Argus, the Legion's homeworld, she says her destiny lies there.
Her feelings are a jumble. I need to focus. Let her thoughts flow into... Ah!
Sands soaked in pain, rivers, rivers of blood.
Skies, a flame, a sword, and the darkness, the wind is burning.
Sssssssss Cuban
Talking to her old soul ain't like chatting with a mortal. Might be why she needed someone to become her speaker.
She's haunted by the Legion and the Old Gods, but there be something more. A greater darkness!
Looks like we've got some preparing to do, champion. You best tell Khadgar what we've learned. Good luck!
The titans built these halls to watch over the soul of the world. From this chamber, I can hear her, clear as diamond.
It is good to see you! Now that the nightmares are gone, we can find out what she wants to tell us. Give the word and we'll begin.
All right, I got everything set up on this end. Activate the power conduits and the pad will be operational.
That's it. Her thoughts be clearing up. She's feeling... fear. Watch out!
Not so much in words. Tismor! Feelings. But not like feelings you or I would have.

Well, let's say you're a world soul, eh? What sort of feelings do you suppose you'd have? Sometimes you feel like a crumbling mountain range, and sometimes you feel like a deep dark sea. I don't know exactly how to describe it.
It felt... like a sunrise.
Revola Rook Mayez Amir!
They must be activated simultaneously. High priest, would you do the honors?
Seekers! Yes! That must be what she meant when she directed me to this place! She wanted us to find these creatures!
So what happened to them?
Again? You've done this before, brother?
Erm, stop it then, will ya?
I sense some corruption amongst my brethren, watch yourself for purification!
Many will come this time. The machine surges with light!
You're wrong about that, Lass. This is why Azeroth called me. Called us here.
She knew it wouldn't be long before the void or took this chamber. She knew who would protect these creatures and use them in service of the Light.
It is you, high priest.
I speak for Azeroth!
Well met!
These stones have tales to tell!
Fight for our world!
For Azeroth!
Back to work!
HENAFIAN NONSENSE!
My magma's fixing to boil!
You messin' with the voice of the planet? THE PLANET!
Now you've done it, it's clobbering time!
Champion, it is good to see a familiar face in these dark times.
Since returning from Argus, the cries of Azeroth have been... overwhelming. Such pain.
I don't know how to fix this, not sure anyone does, but we've got to keep trying.
The Storm's Gathering hero, if we don't find a way to heal Azeroth, nothing else is gonna matter.
Champions, you unified your orders and fought together to drive the Legion from Azeroth.
I know tensions are rising, but I'm calling on you to stand together once more!
Come to Silithus, while we still have a world left to fight for!
The Sword of Sargeras is poisoning the very lifeblood of the world.
The only vessels capable of containing that kind of power are the mighty weapons you wield!
Raise them up as one! Draw out the corruption from the Dark Titan's blade!
Together, champions, for Azeroth!
You did it! Sargeras's sword has gone dormant. Now, Azeroth's not yet healed, but your actions bought us precious time.
The energy coursing through that weapon of yours, I ain't seen nothin' like it! But remember, all power comes with a price.
I know there's much to face in the days ahead, but no matter what comes, never forget our duty to Azeroth!
I feel Argus' soul calling to me again. He's frantic, desperate, and sad, so bloody sad, it breaks my heart.
Place your hand upon the stone when you're ready.
Sargeras is building some kind of dark pantheon. We've got to find Aenar's spirit before Aggramar does.
The life binder! Somehow, she's the key to Sargeras' plan!
We must find her soul! I just don't know how!
This soul fragment calls to me again, but something's different this time. It ain't Argus speaking. It's... another.
It's fainter than the breath of the wind, but it feels so familiar to me. It's like Azeroth's call only, it ain't her.
When Azeroth's spirit speaks to me, it's like a song. There's beauty in it, even when her message ain't exactly clear.
Argus' soul ain't like that. He's tormented, broken. Careful, or his pain'll overwhelm you.
He... He needs us to see something.
Agramar! The fallen titan now serves Sargeras! This is bad. Very bad!
Something ain't right with this place. A presence calls to me from somewhere deep inside the earth.
Champions! I heard a familiar voice calling, so I've fought my way inside this accursed place!
It's A.N.R. The Life Binder. This portal leads to our sanctuary. Go! I'll stay here, cover your backs.
Ser Geras seeks to corrupt the other titans. If we don't stop him, the pantheon will be reborn in darkness. There's no time to waste.
The souls of the Pantheon are free, but they endured so much suffering. Let me bide with them for a time, offer a bit of comfort.
So much agony here, so many voices, it's nearly overwhelming, but I can feel ANR urging us forward.
I feel those demons twisting the spirits of the titans, forcing them to use their might to serve the Legion!
Azeroth!
I'll do what I can to ease the titan spirits, while you put an end to their tortures!
They're using Amunthol's mastery of time against you!
The coven's torments of the high father have taken form!
Golgareth! He's lost in a storm of agony!
The coven strikes at you through the storms of Golganeth!
Cazgrós well is being twisted! He can't control his flame!
The demons are turning the Shapers' flames against you!
They're tearing Norganin's mind to pieces!
Careful! Mortals ain't meant to walk the Dreamweaver's path!
You did it! Agramar's essence is free! He can stand beside his brethren once more!
The titans can sever that connection, but not here. They need to bring the soul of Argus to their place of power, the seat of the Pantheon.
The final act will harness the last of Argus's power to imprison Sargeras once and for all.
I can signal the titans to begin.
You
A sword in the darkness, sands soaked in pain.
The wound burning, burning!
He's fighting through the pain to let us see.
The voice is alone, weak, but so beautiful.
All right everybody, hold on!
Our world needs us, champion!
Azeroth cries out in pain
Her world must be healed."
Remember your duty to Azeroth.
You mean to tell me there's an enormous sword stabbed into the heart of the planet and you've got time to sit around poking me for a laugh? Get back to work!
If only they were using their power to heal Azeroth instead of hurt her, good work champion!
Some earth elementals have been infused with Azirite and are going crazy! Put them down and absorb their Azirite!
It's a shame that Azerite is driving the elements out of control. More reason for us to be putting an end to this.
I can sense Azerite nearby. And those who would seek to abuse it for their own ends, you've got to stop him!
The heart of Azeroth is stronger now, thanks to you, we're one step closer to curing Azeroth of her wounds.
Several Azerite wounds lay exposed nearby. Use the Heart of Azeroth to mend them!
You did well, Champion! I can feel Azeroth recovering her strength, thanks to you!
There's a powerful monstrosity nearby, fueled by the blood of Azeroth herself. You've got to destroy it before it does any harm.
Watch yourself, there's something strong around here, and it's empowered by Azerite!
That's one less blight we need to worry about!
Azeroth is a bit safer, thanks to your efforts!
The heart of Azeroth is the key to healing our world, but you'll need to gather more power if we're to have any chance of succeeding.
Wounds are opening across the face of Azeroth, and more forces are seeking to claim the Azerite for their own ends.
You need to stop them, and absorb that Azerite to empower the heart!
You
Now, unleash the heart's power!
I've got something our champion needs to see, a gift that can aid this land as well.
Come champion, Azeroth herself beckons!
Ah! There you are, champion! I must have words with you!
No need to panic, though I suppose my entrance was a bit abrupt. The name's Magni Bronzebeard. I speak for Azeroth!
Ah! This can take us where we need to go! Come along, champion!
Someone's drawing power from Azerite in this area. You need to stop him!
Azeroth calls to you champion. She offers a gift one born of her own essence
I may be her speaker, but you are her champion and she needs you to fight for her.
The very heart of Azeroth!
Infuse this amulet with power. It might be the only way to save her.
Keep that amulet close to your heart, champion. It'll see you through the dark times ahead.
I'll keep searching for ways to heal the damage done to Azeroth. When I have need of you, I can reach out through that talisman.
Well, hero, you've got work to do. The teleportation pad will take you back to your allies. Good luck to all of us.
Oh, this chamber is in ruins, champion, that won't hold together for long.
I've got something our champion needs to see, a gift that can aid the people of this land.
Champion, I need to speak with you in Silithus. More must be done to heal her world.
If you use your amulet to absorb the Azerite, its power should mend the chamber's seal.
The seal in this chamber protects the world's soul, but with all this Azerite bursting through, the seal is close to shattering!
I sense Azerite nearby, and something drawing a great deal of power from it. You need to stop it!
Excellent! I sense the power returning to Azeroth already!
Someone in this cave is mining Azerite from the world's open wounds. Put a stop to it!
Such a shame, putting their own grid before the health of Azeroth. Thank you, champion!
That's it! I think it's working!
Keep going, just a wee bit more!
No! The seal is shattering! Hold on, lass! Please, hold on!
You did it, champion! The chamber is secure!
Champion, Azeroth cries out for your aid. Come to Silithus, there's something you need to see.
The entrance to the chamber is this way. Come on!
YEAH!!!
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
What?! That thing could barely carry us when I wasn't made of diamond! Ha! I'll take my chances on the ground!
I'll meet you inside, oh dear. BRUN! FLY SAFE!
Ugh! Whatever happens, our champion can handle it! Be ready!
Something's not right! We're losing her!
Take it down or we are done for!
You did it! Hahaha! Hold on! We're getting her out of here!
Now that we've brought you here, can you find a way to heal Azeroth?
Just for analysis? How long before we have a plan of action?
Well, at least there's a start. Thank you, champion. You'll be the first to know when mother finds an answer.
Please to meet you. I'm Magneo!
Exactly! We need your help, mother. Azeroth's dying and nothing we do seems to heal her.
Well, you heard the champion! Let's get to it!
Hold it together Ebenhorn, don't give in to them!
Champion! We've got a problem! Ebenhorn, he...
No! Don't sanitize! Champion, you've got to get back to the chamber right now!
Mother! Why'd you do that?
I suppose Rathian doesn't want to be found, but the knowledge he's accrued could be critical in the fight against N'zoth.
Thank you, champion. I'll get to tracking down the Black Prince. Not too many places you can hide when Azeroth's own speaker is looking for you.
Champion, we need you back in the chamber at once. Ebenhorn's almost gone.
Mother's opened the wake gate to get you back here. Hurry.
When Azeroth called me to be her speaker, she sensed a time of great darkness drawing near.
Through the rise of unspeakable evil, we've clung to a single hope.
You, champion! You are Azeroth's hope!
Thanks to all you've done, that amulet has become mightier than we ever thought possible!
Now, let's get back to saving this world!
Tell our champion what you've found, mother!
Amplify it, you see. How?
The dragon aspects! But they gave up their powers to save the world from Deathwing!
We've got a lead on where to find the first of these essences!
Champion! Mother has a new plan to save Azeroth! Meet us in the Chamber of Heart as soon as you can!
Oh, you're back, champion! And you brought... a tauren!
Ah! It's good to meet a black dragon that isn't trying to kill us all! Abyssian, is it? I'm Magni Bronzebeard!
Did you recover the essence that Mother detected?
You understand the essence better than we do, Eben Horne. We'd be grateful for any guidance you can provide.
There you are, champion. We've made repairs to the Chamber of Heart since you were last here.
Are you ready, champion?
Do you feel that, champion? The heart of Azeroth is brimming with power from the world tree! This is incredible!
Champion! The heart of Azeroth has absorbed a massive amount of power from the Maelstrom! It's stronger than ever before!
Caligos! Well, this is certainly a welcome surprise! What brings you to the Chamber of Heart?
You
Bran, do you make it back to Ironforge often?
Well, it's just, uh, Moira, how has she been?
Aye, you're right. It's just, in some ways it's easier talking to a planet than it is speaking to my own daughter.
I am a plan to, for her mum's sake, and my own.
I know we've got a grim battle ahead of us, but it feels good to be swinging a hammer again.
After all the pain the old gods have inflicted upon Azeroth, I have to do my part in giving him some payback.
Over here, champion! I think I've found who took control of the Forge!
No time to waste! We've got a Titan Forge to reboot!
We're under attack! Protect the chamber!
There's no end to them!
He's... gone.
We need to save him! Mother, can you find us another way inside?
Hold on Raden, we are coming for ya!
You
Thirty-seven! That can't be enough to keep Azeroth protected!
It looks like your work isn't done, champion!
Nicely done, hero. Now to get this thing running again.
Well, that's a good sign!
Oh, it's been ages since I've held a hammer in my hands. Feels good to be back in the action.
Reactivating the engine now! Well, let me see if I can find a console or something for you!
There we go! You can use that console to connect us to the Chamber of Heart.
Hold your horses, lass! This thing didn't exactly come with instructions!
Ouch! That stung!
Wait! It all makes sense now! Connecting the power circuit!
What's this? Interesting! I'll remember that for later!
There! The link is up!
We did it, hero! The Forge is drawing power from the engine of Nalak Shah!
And I found something in the archives that could turn the tide against N'zoth!
Come on, let's get back to the high keeper.
Looks like we'll have to fight our way through. Let's get moving.
Sorry to string that on you lad, but before we go, I have a favour to ask.
I'm gonna be needing my hammer.
Nonsense, lad. I wouldn't have given it to you if you didn't deserve it.
Oh, it's good to feel the heft of a hammer again.
Come jumping, we've got work to do!
You
Mother has connected the Chamber of Heart to all known Titan facilities on Azeroth.
First things first, let's make sure they're all working as intended.
Given how much corruption it used to have, I'd say that's good news!
Inactive! What happened to it?
Wait! See those statues? The Amathite must have reactivated the Forge's defenses!
This is not good.
And you and spies couldn't find the Zoth. Have you had any luck yourself?
Whatever it is, we've got to get Azeroth's Titan-made defenses ready. Then you and our champion need to find us a target to point them at.
Champions! N'zoth is bridging dimensions to assault the Chamber of Heart!
We have to defeat him before he corrupts the soul of Azeroth!
Champions, we're charging the Forge. He's getting weaker. Keep fighting!
The Forge is nearly charged, Champions! Hang in there!
We have full power! Fire!
What do you mean, unstable? Do something!
Mother, can you tell us how to focus the Forge's energies against N'zoth?
We'll have to turn them off before we can cross. The controls should be down below.
Ah, I didn't know you have up your sleeve, lad, but all right. Let's fire it up!
No! You've got to keep fighting, champion!
Don't listen to his lies! You don't belong to him!
You're a child of Azeroth!
Her strength is your strength!
Well then, what are you waiting for?!
HOLD ON CHAMPION!
Champions! We're overrun! We cannae fire!
Mother opened a gateway to the chamber. Champions, Azeroth needs your aid.
You've done it, Champions! Take the fight to N'zoth!
That's all of them! Onward now!
You
I suppose he's annoyed we interrupted his work.
Anomaly? What do you mean?
This cannae be good. I'll meet you back in Uldum.
Hmm, nothing unusual out here.
Look out! The ceiling's caving in!
The entrance is blocked! Mother, get our champion out of here!
Well then, bring them to me! Hero, I'll meet you outside!
Look! Across the sand! That must be the anomaly!
Wait! Do you feel that? Something's wrong.
Oh, that doesn't sound good!
BE CAREFUL, HERO!
You
A nominal amount! Lad, have you lost your mind! We'll be doing the Zoth's work for him!
N'zoth tried to turn the Forge of Origination against us, to reshape the world into his Black Empire. But we'll use it to end them, once and for all.
Mother and I will stay here in the chamber and do what we can to guide you. Good luck!
Come on, let's check inside!
You
That was too close for comfort. Let's go, champion.
You
Was that N'Zoth's doing? I've never seen anything like it!
The Amafit can make their own watchers! We'll have to worry about that later.
We're going to lose the chamber! There's no way to stop him!
You
Hero, can you hear me?
We can't even lose, you hero!
Are you there? Don't you dare give up now!
You
Come on, let's take the lift up to the control chamber.
What the? The power's been shut off! Hang on! I'll get his access to the conduits!
This way, champion!
Luke, some of the consoles here are still active!
If we can figure out which one controls the lift, we can reroute power to it and get it working again.
Ah, this is the lift's console. If we reroute the power here, we can get her running.
This must be where they're powering the defenses we encountered earlier. We can shut this one off.
Re-origination! Back away slowly now, best not to be messing with that!
Norgonon Data Archive! Must be where all of the Forge's diagnostics are stored!
That should do it!
Ah! Why do they have to make this contraption so... convoluted?!
Mother, we're not having any luck rerouting the power. Can you have a go from your end?
Chumpey! Are you there? I thought we lost you for a second.
If N'zoth's minions are inside the Forge, then this is worse than we thought.
We have to, Huddy. Come on!
Looks like the lift is working. The control chamber should be on the third floor.
Here we are. I'll contact the Chamber of Heart.
We took care of them, but not before N'zoth gave the forge a beating.
I'll return to the chamber and start figuring out our next move.
We can't afford to lose the Forge again! Do whatever it takes to protect it!
CHAMPION! MOTHER MAY HAVE FOUND A WAY TO RESTORE THE FORGE OF ORIGINATION!
Meet us at the Chamber of Heart as soon as you can!
You're back! Let's hear what mother has to say!
All of the other forges are working full-time to protect Azeroth! Is there anywhere else we can get that power?
That's it then! Looks like we're heading to Pandaria!
I'll meet you at the entrance to the vaults, champion.
Careful hero, one of these mogu is still kicking!
You what? Well, that's peculiar.
Ugh, what are we gonna do now?
